response.sql: WITH frequency_averages AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) AS signed_average, AVG(t.balance) AS balance_average FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY a.frequency), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(signed_average) AS signed_mean FROM frequency_averages) SELECT AVG(f.signed_average) AS average_signed_amount, AVG(f.balance_average) AS average_balance, AVG(f.signed_average - m.signed_mean) AS average_excess FROM frequency_averages AS f CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE f.signed_average > m.signed_mean;
